Implement tenacity.retry.retry_if_exception_group(predicate,*,mode="all") as retry_base. On a failed outcome traverse nested BaseExceptionGroup leaves iteratively in source order, apply all/any short-circuit logic; ordinary exceptions are a single leaf. Success returns False without invoking the predicate; missing outcome raises RuntimeError. Preserve leaf identity, original exception structure, predicate exceptions and composition with retry_all/retry_any. Validate callable/mode; integrate with actual Retrying without flattening or replacing delivered groups. This feature targets the pinned Python 3.12 environment.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_tn_group_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-tn-group-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Add tenacity.stop.stop_before_idle_budget(budget) as stop_base. Accept nonnegative finite seconds or timedelta, rejecting booleans/nonfinite/negative values. Stop when retry_state.idle_for + upcoming_sleep is greater than or equal to budget, before that next sleep is issued. Count only retry waiting, not target execution elapsed time; a zero budget stops after the first rejected attempt even for zero wait. Integrate with actual Retrying and AsyncRetrying and stop_any/stop_all without storing mutable per-call counters in the shared policy. Preserve other stop and wait semantics.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_tn_idle_budget_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-tn-idle-budget-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

Implement tenacity.history.RetryHistory(max_entries=20) with wrap(fn), immutable records snapshot and clear(). Wrap actual sync/async target attempts, recording frozen AttemptRecord(sequence,elapsed,succeeded,exception_type) on each completed success or BaseException, preserving return identity and reraising the same exception. Bound storage, retain monotonic unique sequence across clear, protect concurrent snapshot and append, and preserve function metadata. Store no arguments, result values, exception objects/messages or tracebacks. Integrate by passing wrapped target into existing retry controllers; do not claim automatic per-call isolation or record an unawaited coroutine as a successful attempt.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/development_tests/test_development_tn_history_dev.py and concise Chinese compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-tn-history-dev.md.
